title: An Act relative to the Pilgrim Memorial Park in Plymouth

abstracts.abstract: By Representatives LaNatra of Kingston and Badger of Plymouth, a petition (subject to Joint Rule 12) of Kathleen R. LaNatra that the Commissioner of Capital Asset Management and Maintenance be authorized to enter into lease with the town of Plymouth for Pilgrim Memorial Park in said town.  State Administration and Regulatory Oversight.
